extraction.notes: All figures from Attachment 2 (page seq 9, printed 3), three-month 2022 column, in thousands. FFO subtotal used is diluted FFO ($185,849), which includes the Series E preferred distributions ($1,092) as a nareit_other add-back; basic FFO ($184,757) is an intermediate subtotal reached before that line. Dashed (-) 2022 items are recorded as 0. 'Variable upside participation on DCP, net' ($(10,622)) is categorized as 'other' since it does not clearly fit a listed category. Checks: 185,849/344,132 = $0.54; 188,629/344,132 = $0.55; 176,825/344,132 = $0.51. AFFO subtracts recurring capex, so no separate disclosure needed.
